propositions: Phase 1 removed 29,931 marked duplicates but skipped 836 unmarked truncated comments across three issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) because the reconciler marker was cut off by the 32767-character truncation
The marker is appended after the comment body, so truncation removes it, making the loop-breaker ineffective for over-length comments
Phase 2 removes the 836 orphaned duplicates using a two-condition rule: presence of truncation suffix AND absence of marker
Phase 2 execution deleted 827 comments (838 candidates minus 1 transient error) across exactly the three expected issues with zero data loss, keeping the oldest copy per distinct body
After bridge re-enablement, these issues will receive one new copy per distinct truncated body (roughly 8 total), then dedupe from pass 2 onward
The final sweep must invert the keep-one rule to preserve the newest copy (the one recorded in comment_ids) rather than the oldest, to avoid recreating the original defect
